title: Desenvolvedor php
description:
Curte resolver problemas com dados? A gente está procurando alguém que mande bem em PHP, MySQL e Laravel, e que tope encarar o desafio de importar, transformar e validar grandes volumes de dados de outros sistemas.


O foco principal será importação, transformação e integração de dados — mas o trabalho não se limita a isso: você também vai atuar em melhorias gerais no sistema, integrações com APIs, performance e escalabilidade da arquitetura backend.


Aqui você vai trabalhar com:


✅PHP (orientado a objetos)

✅MySQL avançado (queries complexas, modelagem e performance)

✅Laravel (migrations, jobs, eventos, filas)

✅Processamento assíncrono e foco em escalabilidade


Diferenciais que somam:


Laravel Octane

Vue.js

APIs REST

Docker e CI/CD


Vaga PJ


 Empresa com grandes planos de crescimento — e espaço real pra você crescer junto.

title: Senior Android Software Developer
description:
Project Description:

Open Video project is focused on OTT platform development for one of the largest North American TV providers. We are looking for Senior Software Developer who will be working on software development for the client hardware platform based on Android OS.


Responsibilities:

Responsible for development of embedded software engineering projects for Set-Top Box hardware using the latest software solutions and techniques. Work as an individual contributor while providing technical guidance to development and integration projects. Coordinate development process of Set-Top Box projects for various hardware platforms. Languages:

title: Electrical VDC Team Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil. Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be apart of --> eracore.com


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

We’re looking for a Content Writer to craft high-quality business and strategy questions, case studies, and structured content across diverse management domains with No prior AI experience required . This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical skills, excellent written English, and an MBA/business background who enjoys turning complex ideas into clear, engaging content


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop business/strategy questions in finance, public policy, e-commerce, sports analytics, etc.
  • Create case studies and real-world scenarios for MBA-level learners.
  • Organize content using structured formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • Ensure clarity, accuracy, and professionalism in all outputs.
  • Collaborate with experts to align content with real-world applications.


What We’re Looking For:

  • MBA or bachelor’s from a Tier-1/2 institute in business, economics, commerce, or management.
  • 1–5 years’ experience in content, consulting, research, or analysis.
  • Strong logical/analytical thinking and excellent written English.
  • Familiarity with structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior experience in case study writing or academic/business content.


Why Join Us:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Flexible, remote-first environment.
  • Competitive pay with potential contract extensions.
  • Freelance perks: exposure to advanced AI, flexible hours, global collaboration.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Business Development Intern
description:
We are looking for a motivated student to join our international Sales Team and support business development activities in the public sector across various countries. Are you currently studying, would you like to gain professional experience alongside your studies and get to know an innovative employer? Then apply - we look forward to hearing from you! You will be part of a diverse and collaborative team spread across multiple locations, working closely with experienced professionals to identify, evaluate, and pursue opportunities in different areas.


Job Definition

> Scout and assess opportunities in the public sector via procurement portals in different countries

> Support the preparation of proposals by gathering relevant data and documentation

> Create and tailor project references and CVs to meet tender requirements

> Collaborate with team members to maintain an internal knowledge base of public tenders and best practices


Job Qualifications

> Fluent in Portuguese, with business-level proficiency in German and English (B2-C1)

> Very good knowledge in MS-Office, mainly MS-Excel, and MS-Teams

> Strong planning, organizational, and communication skills

> Reliable, detail-oriented, and proactive, able to take ownership and motivated to learn quickly

> Interest in public sector processes, international collaboration, and technology-driven projects

> Previous experience with procurement in the public sector will be seen as a plus


Benefits

> A highly innovative, agile and unique team with a great working culture and an employer that appreciates new initiatives and ideas

> We support, offer and cover the cost of language courses from level A1 to C1

> Enjoy daily supportive lunch provisions and benefits

> We support you to help you grow individually by a variety of training programmes

Apply now!


Pixida is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer!

We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires and respects all individuals and in which all aspects of employment are applied without discrimination. Therefore we encourage all individuals to apply!


Please provide your CV (already with certificates, employer's references, etc.) In addition, we ask you to provide information about your possible start date, salary expectations and language skills.

title: Account Manager
description:
Role: Account Manager - B2B iGaming

Location: Brazil


A leading international provider of digital entertainment solutions is looking for an Account Manager to oversee and grow client relationships within the Brazilian market.


In this role, you will be part of a dynamic Account Management team focused on revenue growth, client success, and the effective delivery of gaming solutions across Latin America.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Serve as the main point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring consistent communication and satisfaction
  • Take full commercial ownership of accounts, driving revenue growth and achieving performance objectives
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with client needs and business goals
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights and guidance to optimize client operations and promotional strategies
  • Ensure timely delivery of gaming products and solutions according to client requirements
  • Monitor and report on monthly revenue performance, identifying opportunities for growth
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships at all organizational levels
  • Represent the company at industry exhibitions, conferences, and networking events
  • Promote and uphold the organization’s values and brand reputation


Requirements:


  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in B2B account management within the iGaming industry, ideally for a slot or game provider
  • Fluent in Brazilian Portuguese and English; Spanish fluency is an advantage
  • Native or resident of a LATAM market (for example Brazil, Colombia, or Peru)
  • Proven ability to manage high-value accounts and build long-term client partnerships
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with experience engaging stakeholders at all levels
  • Demonstrated success in delivering client-focused solutions that meet strategic business goals
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and promotion management tools preferred
  • Highly proactive, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, data-driven approach
  • Willingness to travel and represent the company at industry events


What’s Offered:


  • Competitive salary with annual performance reviews
  • Transparent quarterly bonus structure based on results
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and a partner
  • Financial assistance for significant life events
  • Reimbursement for professional development, training, and educational courses
company: Clear Edge International Search & Selection Ltd

title: AI Agent Developer Jr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Analista de Automação de IA Jr

Contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mão na massa e experiência prática comprovada em ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
  • Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
  • Aplicar IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Noções de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento introdutório ou prático em IA generativa e uso de modelos como ChatGPT.
  • Organização, curiosidade, boa comunicação e autonomia para aprender fazendo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e entregar soluções com qualidade, mesmo em contextos de baixa complexidade.


Diferenciais

  • Já ter desenvolvido bots ou agentes internos, mesmo em projetos pessoais ou freelas.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Teams Bot Framework ou WhatsApp Business API.
  • Noções de Machine Learning, fluxos com NLP ou experiências com LLMs.
  • Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou hackathons.
  • Conhecimento em documentação técnica e lógica de versionamento (ex: ReadMe, Notion, Git).

Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

title: Analista de Operações & Sistemas em Consultoria de Investimentos
description:
>> Sobre a Oportunidade

Com remuneração inicial de R$ 4.000/mês e modelo remoto , esta é uma oportunidade para quem busca crescer em um ambiente de alta performance e com perspectiva de crescimento, incluindo possibilidade de evolução para o Programa de Partnership.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Operações & Sistemas , contratado(a) como prestador de serviços PJ , para apoiar nossas operações internas, fortalecer a organização dos processos e contribuir no desenvolvimento de ferramentas que impulsionam nossa operação.


A Horizon Advisors é uma Consultoria de Investimentos guiada por valores sólidos como transparência, excelência, independência e foco genuíno no cliente. Trabalhamos com processos bem estruturados, tecnologia e uma cultura que valoriza precisão, consistência e melhoria contínua. Buscamos alguém que compartilhe desses valores e queira crescer junto com a empresa .


>> Principais Responsabilidades

O(a) profissional será responsável por prestar serviços que envolvem:

  • Apoio às rotinas operacionais ligadas à execução, conferência e consolidação de aplicações financeiras;
  • Atualização de controles internos e acompanhamento de movimentações;
  • Identificação de melhorias e contribuições para tornar processos e controles internos mais eficientes e confiáveis;
  • Auxílio no desenvolvimento de ferramentas em Excel e plataformas low-code (ex.: Bubble.io e Zapier);
  • Comunicação clara com o time quando houver pendências, inconsistências ou necessidade de alinhamento.


>> Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído;
  • Organização rigorosa e forte atenção aos detalhes;
  • Experiência prévia em backoffice, operações ou suporte em instituições financeiras, gestoras, escritórios de investimento, fintechs ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets em nível avançado;
  • Facilidade para aprender e operar novos sistemas e ferramentas;
  • Computador próprio com acesso estável à internet;
  • Interesse genuíno em desenvolver carreira no mercado financeiro.


>> Diferenciais

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com Bubble.io ou outras ferramentas low-code/no-code;
  • Certificação CPA-10, CPA-20 ou CEA;
  • Afinidade com tecnologia, APIs e integrações simples.

title: Líder Técnico III (Web/Mobile/Servidores)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar na liderança técnica de projetos de software, no ICC PDI SW.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de desenvolvimento de software; propondo soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam performáticas e flexíveis, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções integradas;
  • Realizar a especificação funcional de projetos, definindo e documentando arquitetura lógica e executável de sistemas;
  • Projetar software para integração e entrega contínua;
  • Prover solução e suporte para o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de aplicações móveis, web e servidora;
  • Desenvolver aplicações de alto nível;
  • Realizar o planejamento e o monitoramento das atividades técnicas dos projetos.
  • Prover capacitação, orientação e suporte técnico aos desenvolvedores;
  • Revisar código desenvolvido conforme boas práticas da tecnologia;
  • Prover suporte ao time de QA;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do projeto, operacionais e de apoio à gerência;
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos artefatos técnicos desenvolvidos;
  • Desenvolver e manter padrões de codificação e documentação técnica, promovendo a adoção de novas tecnologias e metodologias;
  • Resolver problemas técnicos complexos e fornecer suporte técnico à equipe, removendo impedimentos e facilitando o progresso do trabalho.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;
  • Vivência na gestão de projetos ligados a tecnologias Mobile
  • Experiência em práticas de DevOps, incluindo Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD e monitoramento;
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento de soluções Web, aplicações móveis e soluções em nuvem;
  • Domínio em banco de dados não relacional/relacional, Webservices, Design patterns, Modelagem de projetos, Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum, e ferramentas de gestão de projetos como JIRA;
  • Conhecimentos em testes automatizados e unitários e ferramentas de design UX/UI.



Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.


Local de trabalho : As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho "Home Office".

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Líder Técnico III - Visão Computacional
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar na liderança técnica de projetos de Inteligência Artificial, com foco em Visão Computacional, no Inatel Competence Center - PDI SW.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir a estratégia técnica do projeto, desenvolver e comunicando uma visão clara e estratégica para a aplicação de Inteligência Artificial, Visão Computacional e Data Science na Instituição;
  • Orientar desenvolvimento de Modelos Avançados, supervisionando a equipe na criação de modelos estatísticos e de aprendizado de máquina utilizando técnicas avançadas e modernas;
  • Aplicar e conceber arquitetura de soluções inovadoras para plataformas Network as a Service (NaaS) com foco em integração de técnicas de IA e ML;
  • Realizar estudos aprofundados e análises de estruturas, dados, plataformas e ferramentas de IA/ML, fornecendo insights valiosos para tomada de decisões;
  • Preparar documentações estratégica e técnica abrangente sobre as soluções propostas e adotadas, garantindo a compreensão e rastreabilidade dos projetos;
  • Liderar o Time de QA, provendo orientação e suporte ao time de Garantia da Qualidade para garantir a confiabilidade e robustez das soluções implementadas;
  • Executar revisão técnica proativa, examinar o código desenvolvido e assegurar que ele esteja em conformidade com as melhores práticas da tecnologia e promovendo a melhoria contínua;
  • Atuar como Multiplicador de Conhecimento, oferecendo suporte técnico e mentorship aos colegas, promovendo o desenvolvimento da equipe.


Requisitos e qualificações


Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiência em:

  • Linguagem de programação Python ou Go,
  • Métodos estatísticos para análise de dados,
  • Desenvolvimento de algoritmos de Machine Learning/Deep Learning,
  • Arquitetura em microserviços,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web modernas,
  • Banco de dados de alto volume (relacional, não relacional, data lake ou data warehouse);


Conhecimentos em:

  • Conhecimento em Keras, PyTorch e TensorFlow,
  • MLOps,
  • Plataformas Cloud (AWS ou Azure),
  • CI/CD,
  • Melhores práticas de desenvolvimento,
  • Metodologias ágeis.


Seria interessante se você tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em soluções SDN;
  • Prática em projetos com equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimentos em: Big Data, Data Science, gRPC, banco de dados temporal e mock de dados;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura e escrita e intermediário para conversação.


Informações adicionais

Horário das atividades: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.


Local das atividades: As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de teletrabalho "home office".

title: Site Reliability Engineer Sr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Site Reliability Engineer Sr (SRE Sr)

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar, manter e escalar soluções resilientes, de alta disponibilidade e performance em cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automatização;
  • Automatizar tudo que for possível (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Otimizar performance, definir e monitorar SLOs junto ao time de produto.
  • Atuar em incidentes e ajudar a reduzir MTTR.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia usando melhores práticas em SRE;
  • Experiência em ambientes Multi-cloud (OCI ou AWS) ou híbridos;
  • Atuação com CI/CD (GitLab, ArgoCD e similares);
  • Experiência solida com Infrastructure as Code (Terraform e similares)
  • Automação e scripting (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell);
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel).
  • Domínio de containers e Kubernetes.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering;
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Certificações em Cloud.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
About us


We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Spanish and English.

title: Front End AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview:


We are seeking a Front End AI Engineer with deep expertise in building high-quality, production-ready interfaces for AI-powered applications. This role focuses on leading the front-end architecture for advanced AI systems, including conversational interfaces, agent control panels, automation dashboards, and embedded AI workflows for client deployments. The ideal candidate is fluent in modern React, highly skilled in TypeScript, comfortable working across design systems, and efficient with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

This is a senior-level role where you will serve as the point person for all front-end initiatives across multiple client projects. You will collaborate closely with our AI, automation, and product teams to translate complex agentic and generative AI capabilities into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance user experiences.


Key Responsibilities:


Front End Architecture and Development

  • Own the front-end strategy and implementation for AI-powered products and interfaces.
  • Build high-quality React applications using TypeScript, modular component architectures, and modern state management patterns.
  • Experience with design and Figma.
  • Use AI-enhanced development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development, improve quality, and maintain consistency across projects.
  • Design reusable component libraries tailored for AI interfaces, including chat interfaces, agent dashboards, workflow builders, analytics panels, and data visualization.
  • Ensure UX clarity when surfacing complex AI behavior, including agent states, reasoning paths, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Coordinate with the backend and AI engineering teams to integrate REST APIs, WebSockets, vector search endpoints, automation pipelines, and generative model outputs.
  • Lead code reviews, establish front-end standards, and mentor engineers on best practices in AI-driven front-end development.


AI Interface Development

  • Build highly responsive conversational UI components for voice and text-based agents.
  • Develop systems to visualize agentic operations, multi-step workflows, and tool usage.
  • Implement secure user authentication and permissions for client-facing AI dashboards.
  • Work with designers to translate conceptual AI workflows into intuitive user flows and polished UI.
  • Collaborate with the AI engineering team to improve prompt workflows, data capture, and human override safety controls from the front-end layer.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary owner and technical authority for front-end delivery across all AI engagements.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers, and automation specialists to define scope and translate requirements into clear front-end plans.
  • Help clients understand interface possibilities and guide them toward the most effective implementation strategies.
  • Ensure that front-end systems meet client needs around reliability, accessibility, and performance.


Qualifications:


Required

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a front-end engineer.
  • Expert-level proficiency in React and TypeScript.
  • Design experience and using tools like Figma.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex front-end applications from architecture through deployment.
  • Comfortable with AI-enhanced coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and related platforms.
  • Familiarity with building AI-enabled interfaces, including chat UIs, real-time dashboards, visual workflows, or similar components.
  • Strong experience with API integration, authentication, and state management patterns.
  • Ability to work independently, set technical direction, and mentor less experienced developers.
  • Strong UX instincts and the ability to translate technical AI functionality into clear and usable interfaces.


Preferred

  • Experience building interfaces for LLM-powered systems, automation workflows, or agent-based applications.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval augmented UIs.
  • Experience with streaming updates, event-driven front-end patterns, or real-time systems.
  • Background in building interfaces for enterprise clients or complex operational environments.
  • Experience collaborating with AI engineers on prompt workflows and agent control features.


Work Environment and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation structure with performance incentives.
  • Flexible remote or hybrid work environment.
  • Opportunity to shape the front-end architecture for cutting-edge AI systems across multiple industries.
  • High-impact work with clients committed to modernization and operational transformation.

This role focuses on leading the front-end architecture for advanced AI systems, including conversational interfaces, agent control panels, automation dashboards, and embedded AI workflows for client deployments. The ideal candidate is fluent in modern React, highly skilled in TypeScript, comfortable working across design systems, and efficient with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

This is a senior-level role where you will serve as the point person for all front-end initiatives across multiple client projects. You will collaborate closely with our AI, automation, and product teams to translate complex agentic and generative AI capabilities into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance user experiences.


Key Responsibilities:


Front End Architecture and Development

  • Own the front-end strategy and implementation for AI-powered products and interfaces.
  • Build high-quality React applications using TypeScript, modular component architectures, and modern state management patterns.
  • Experience with design and Figma.
  • Use AI-enhanced development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development, improve quality, and maintain consistency across projects.
  • Design reusable component libraries tailored for AI interfaces, including chat interfaces, agent dashboards, workflow builders, analytics panels, and data visualization.
  • Ensure UX clarity when surfacing complex AI behavior, including agent states, reasoning paths, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Coordinate with the backend and AI engineering teams to integrate REST APIs, WebSockets, vector search endpoints, automation pipelines, and generative model outputs.
  • Lead code reviews, establish front-end standards, and mentor engineers on best practices in AI-driven front-end development.


AI Interface Development

  • Build highly responsive conversational UI components for voice and text-based agents.
  • Develop systems to visualize agentic operations, multi-step workflows, and tool usage.
  • Implement secure user authentication and permissions for client-facing AI dashboards.
  • Work with designers to translate conceptual AI workflows into intuitive user flows and polished UI.
  • Collaborate with the AI engineering team to improve prompt workflows, data capture, and human override safety controls from the front-end layer.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary owner and technical authority for front-end delivery across all AI engagements.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers, and automation specialists to define scope and translate requirements into clear front-end plans.
  • Help clients understand interface possibilities and guide them toward the most effective implementation strategies.
  • Ensure that front-end systems meet client needs around reliability, accessibility, and performance.


Qualifications:


Required

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a front-end engineer.
  • Expert-level proficiency in React and TypeScript.
  • Design experience and using tools like Figma.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex front-end applications from architecture through deployment.
  • Comfortable with AI-enhanced coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and related platforms.
  • Familiarity with building AI-enabled interfaces, including chat UIs, real-time dashboards, visual workflows, or similar components.
  • Strong experience with API integration, authentication, and state management patterns.
  • Ability to work independently, set technical direction, and mentor less experienced developers.
  • Strong UX instincts and the ability to translate technical AI functionality into clear and usable interfaces.


Preferred

  • Experience building interfaces for LLM-powered systems, automation workflows, or agent-based applications.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval augmented UIs.
  • Experience with streaming updates, event-driven front-end patterns, or real-time systems.
  • Background in building interfaces for enterprise clients or complex operational environments.
  • Experience collaborating with AI engineers on prompt workflows and agent control features.


Work Environment and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation structure with performance incentives.
  • Flexible remote or hybrid work environment.
  • Opportunity to shape the front-end architecture for cutting-edge AI systems across multiple industries.
  • High-impact work with clients committed to modernization and operational transformation.

title: PMO Sênior (Inglês Fluente) – 100% Remoto
description:
PMO Sênior (Inglês Fluente) – 100% Remoto - PJ


Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como líder e referência em governança de projetos, apoiando Gerentes de Projeto e Scrum Masters na aplicação de metodologias e boas práticas.
  • Estruturar, implementar e evoluir processos padronizados de gestão de projetos em ambientes ágeis, tradicionais e híbridos.
  • Coordenar o portfólio de projetos da organização, garantindo alinhamento estratégico entre iniciativas, metas de negócio e prioridades executivas.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos métodos, ferramentas e indicadores de performance dos projetos.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre áreas de negócio, equipes técnicas e alta gestão, assegurando visibilidade, previsibilidade e transparência na execução.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho, riscos e indicadores de maturidade organizacional em projetos.
  • Oferecer mentoria e suporte técnico a Gerentes de Projeto e Scrum Masters, impulsionando a cultura de colaboração e agilidade.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e painéis de acompanhamento em inglês para stakeholders globais.
  • Atuar como elo entre a estratégia corporativa e a execução dos projetos, garantindo entregas de alto valor e conformidade com padrões organizacionais.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência consolidada em funções de PMO, PM ou liderança de portfólio de projetos, preferencialmente em ambientes de tecnologia.
  • Vivência na coordenação e mentoria de equipes de Gerentes de Projeto e Scrum Masters.
  • Sólido domínio de metodologias PMI (PMBOK) e Agile (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe ou híbridas).
  • Proficiência em ferramentas como MS Project, Azure Boards, Jira, Power BI ou similares.
  • Fluência em inglês (oral e escrita) para comunicação com stakeholders internacionais.
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança, comunicação e influência organizacional.
  • Capacidade analítica para avaliação de desempenho, mitigação de riscos e planejamento estratégico.


Diferenciais:


  • Certificações como PMP, PMI-PgMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência prévia em estruturar ou maturar escritórios de projetos (PMO).
  • Atuação em empresas multinacionais ou projetos com times distribuídos globalmente.
  • Experiência no setor de Manufatura ou em iniciativas de Transformação Digital.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Business Analyst to manage and mentor a team of analysts creating business-focused content to improve AI models. You’ll combine leadership, quality oversight, and subject expertise in MBA-relevant domains to ensure outputs are accurate, logically sound, and aligned with project goals. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys people management, operational excellence, and shaping high-quality analytical content. No prior AI experience is required for this role.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts/Content Specialists.
  • Allocate tasks, oversee workflows, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Conduct QA reviews, refine processes, and improve team efficiency.
  • Provide performance feedback, training, and career development.
  • Act as the primary stakeholder contact, sharing regular project updates.
  • Guide creation of case studies, scenarios, and structured business content (finance, policy, e-commerce, etc.).


What We’re Looking For:

  • 2+ years of team management experience.
  • 3–6 years in business analysis, consulting, content, or domain-focused projects.
  • Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior work on LLM performance data, case study writing, or academic/research content.
  • Full-time commitment (40 hrs/week); immediate joiners preferred.


Why Join Us:

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Lead a team working on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Venture Capital Analyst
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners is a global financial and strategic advisory firm that connects visionary entrepreneurs with strategic capital. We support innovative companies in scaling through high-impact capital partnerships, leveraging our international investor network, deep market intelligence, and long-term value–driven approach. Our work goes beyond traditional capital matchmaking—combining proprietary sourcing, strategic insight, and a commitment to supporting founders throughout their growth journey.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and analytically minded Venture Capital Analyst with a strong focus on developing investor-facing materials. In this role, you will craft, refine, and manage core content that supports our portfolio companies throughout their fundraising journeys—including pitch decks, one-pagers, and strategic narratives.


This position is ideal for someone who understands the venture landscape and excels at translating complex business models into compelling investment materials. You will collaborate with internal teams, portfolio founders, and design partners to ensure each presentation is both insightful and visually aligned with Evvolve’s high standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation, iteration, and finalization of investment materials (e.g., pitch decks, one-pagers, fundraising briefs).
  • Synthesize business models, market analyses, and competitive landscapes into concise and impactful presentations.
  • Collaborate closely with founders, internal deal teams, and design resources to ensure alignment in messaging, structure, and visuals.
  • Apply insights from investor conversations and market trends to tailor narratives for specific capital partners.
  • Ensure materials meet the strategic objectives of each raise while adhering to Evvolve’s brand and communication standards.
  • Maintain strong quality control and consistency across deliverables, often managing several projects simultaneously.


What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, consulting, or a comparable analyst-level role.
  • Strong proficiency in presentation tools (PowerPoint required; Figma a strong plus).
  • Clear understanding of early-stage fundraising processes and startup growth dynamics.
  • Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex ideas into compelling content.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong sense of ownership over deliverables.


Why Join Us

  • Join a mission-driven team shaping the future of venture capital and innovation.
  • Work with a global network of top-tier investors and high-impact founders.
  • Gain exposure to diverse sectors—from AI to sustainability to frontier technologies.
  • Play a critical role in the capital-raising process for fast-growing ventures.
  • Enjoy a flexible work environment with opportunities for global travel and cross-office collaboration.

title: Software Engineer (Murex)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Murex Developer to join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins as fully remote , with the expectation of relocation to Portugal after an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of the Murex MX.3 platform.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations within Murex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
  • Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and MxML Exchange interfaces.
  • Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
  • Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Murex MX.3 (configuration, development, or integration).
  • Solid knowledge of Datamart, MxML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
  • Strong programming skills: Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
  • Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Willingness and eligibility to relocate to Portugal after the initial remote period.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum .
  • Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.

Desired Profile

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
  • Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
  • Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.

What We Offer

  • Remote work during the initial phase.
  • Support and guidance for future relocation to Portugal .
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
  • Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.

title: Consultor PMO
description:
Consultor PMO (NearShore)


Buscamos um consultor de (PMO) , alocado no modelo NearShore pelo Brasil 100% remoto, que possa oferecer cobertura até pelo menos meia-noite horário EST, conforme as atividades abaixo.

É necessário possuir excelente comunicação verbal e habilidade para preparar apresentações, slides e decks.

Disponibilidade total para atuar durante o horário EST (até 4–5 pm no horário dos EUA), com bom entendimento de terminologias de negócios, excelente comunicação e forte capacidade de apresentação.


O profissional deve garantir entregas rápidas, como publicação de notas e ações no mesmo dia (incluindo refinamento de notas geradas por IA, follow-ups etc.), para apoiar múltiplas iniciativas em paralelo (5–6 reuniões por dia).


Responsabilidades Principais:

O Consultor (PMO) será responsável por apoiar o processo de desenvolvimento, incluindo:

  • Preparar apresentações e slide decks conforme orientações do time de negócios
  • Participar de reuniões, registrar notas detalhadas e publicar atas
  • Desenvolver cronogramas detalhados para iniciativas relacionadas ao projeto de aprimoramento de relatórios financeiros
  • Organizar e participar de reuniões recorrentes para monitorar e acompanhar itens de ação e marcos do cronograma
  • Desenvolver e manter documentação seguindo padrões definidos e estrutura de arquivamento estabelecida
  • Produzir relatórios, listas e análises básicas em Excel conforme orientações do negócio
  • Redigir comunicações por e-mail conforme direcionamento do time de negócios


Detalhes Relevantes:

Modelo de contrato: Pessoa Jurídica - Prestador de Serviços de TI

Tempo de contrato: 6 meses renovável

Inglês: Fluente/Avançado - Todo processo será conduzido em Inglês (Cliente localizado nos EUA)

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities

description:

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

  • Apoiar o time tecnicamente com os projetos, garantindo a qualidade técnica e a eficácia do desenvolvimento;
  • Manutenção nas funcionalidades existentes;
  • Documentação técnica dentro do escopo do time;
  • Análise e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo;
  • Colaboração com o time na definição de novas abordagens ou tecnologias.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java (11+);
  • Conhecimento em Spring e Spring Boot;
  • Conhecimento em Ruby;
  • APIs e integrações;
  • Experiência em RESTful APIs;
  • Conhecimento em cloud computing;
  • Conhecimento em AWS;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança da informação;
  • Autenticação, Autorização e Criptografia;
  • Prevenção de ataques.


Diferenciais:

  • Familiaridade com frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas Atlassian: JIRA e Confluence;
  • Experiência React e React Native;
  • Experiência JavaScript (Node.js);
  • Axway - API Gateway;
  • Conhecimento em Continuous Integration: Git, Jenkins e Docker;
  • Mensageria;
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.



Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios

  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.

title: Customer Success Consultant
description:
Customer Success & Business Development Consultant – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for 118 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to support delivering services that combine customer success expertise with business development activities, focusing on consultative engagement, solution-oriented selling, and collaborative account management.


Key Deliveries include:

Customer Success & Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and enablement sessions for CAS users.
  • Provide guidance to help customers realize the full value of CAS solutions.
  • Maintain strong relationships across multiple levels within client organizations.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities to grow, retain, and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Develop a pipeline of new business opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Conduct prospecting activities, including calls, emails, and presentations.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations and messaging to build awareness of CAS solutions.
  • Support marketing activities such as workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities in CRM (Salesforce/LEX).
  • Provide regular progress updates on engagement metrics and deliverables.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science-related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, account management, customer success, and business development.
  • English fluency (written and spoken); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX) and virtual meeting tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx).
  • Dynamic, proactive, and collaborative mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Required Expertise:

  • Proven success in solution-based sales and consultative engagement.
  • Strong ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
  • Skilled in relationship building across organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with scientific information tools and intellectual property solutions (preferred).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.


To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to

title: "Desenvolvedor Java Pleno#987541"
description:
A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós:

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente:

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de indústria


O que você deve ter:

• Experiência sólida com Java 8+ em ambientes corporativos.

• Domínio de frameworks como Spring, Spring Boot, Spring MVC.

• Implementação de APIs REST e SOAP com boas práticas de segurança e versionamento.

• Experiência com servidores de aplicação: Tomcat, WildFly/JBoss ou equivalentes.

• Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST/SOAP.

• Manipulação de arquivos CSV, TXT, XML.

• Familiaridade com integrações legadas e arquiteturas híbridas.

• SQL avançado: joins complexos, triggers, views, procedures.

• Experiência com Oracle, SQL Server ou PostgreSQL.

• Capacidade de tuning, otimização de consultas e análise de planos de execução.

• Construção e manutenção de scripts e rotinas de banco.

• Uso de ferramentas de versionamento, especialmente Git.

• Conhecimento de logs, monitoramento e ferramentas de troubleshooting.

• Experiência com ambientes Linux e execução de serviços Java.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós:

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente:

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de indústria


O que você deve ter:

• Experiência sólida com Java 8+ em ambientes corporativos.

• Domínio de frameworks como Spring, Spring Boot, Spring MVC.

• Implementação de APIs REST e SOAP com boas práticas de segurança e versionamento.

• Experiência com servidores de aplicação: Tomcat, WildFly/JBoss ou equivalentes.

• Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST/SOAP.

• Manipulação de arquivos CSV, TXT, XML.

• Familiaridade com integrações legadas e arquiteturas híbridas.

• SQL avançado: joins complexos, triggers, views, procedures.

• Experiência com Oracle, SQL Server ou PostgreSQL.

• Capacidade de tuning, otimização de consultas e análise de planos de execução.

• Construção e manutenção de scripts e rotinas de banco.

• Uso de ferramentas de versionamento, especialmente Git.

• Conhecimento de logs, monitoramento e ferramentas de troubleshooting.

• Experiência com ambientes Linux e execução de serviços Java.

title: Representante de vendas
description:
Empresa: Cross Map

Consultoria especializada em controles internos, auditoria e governança corporativa.


Quer ter a chance de atuar com empresas de médio e grande porte em todo o Brasil, ajudando clientes a fortalecer processos, reduzir riscos e aumentar eficiência? Essa pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para você!


Como Representante de Vendas suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Prospectar empresas potenciais que possam se beneficiar dos serviços da CrossMap;
  • Ampliar a base de clientes e relacionamentos corporativos, com foco em empresas da região de São Paulo (podendo expandir nacionalmente);
  • Conduzir apresentações institucionais;
  • Intermediar o relacionamento com o cliente até a contratação;
  • Conectar oportunidades à equipe técnica da CrossMap para fechamento da oportunidade.


Para isso buscamos alguém com:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Interesse em aprender sobre soluções de controles internos, auditoria e governança;
  • Boa comunicação, postura profissional e organização.


⭐ Será considerado como diferencial:

  • Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas, representação comercial ou relacionamento B2B;
  • Rede de contatos corporativos (CFOs, controllers, gestores de compras, compliance, etc.).


Modelo de atuação:

  • PJ / Autônomo;
  • Atuação sem exclusividade: O profissional pode manter outras representações ou outras atividades;
  • Horário livre: Atuação independente onde o representante organiza sua própria rotina, sem controle de jornada;
  • Atuação 100% remota.


Remuneração:

  • Vaga 100% comissionada: Sem teto de ganhos e sem custo fixo para o representante;
  • Percentual de comissão competitivo: Calculado sobre o valor do contrato fechado;
  • Comissão baseada em sucesso (success fee): O pagamento ocorre a partir da assinatura de contrato com o cliente indicado pelo representante.
